title: Guided reading: Ephesians 2:4–5
subtitle: Read participle, contrast, and grace language.
overview: This passage makes the contrast visible: a participial description of human condition is followed by God as the main subject and action.
Track the dative τῇ χάριτι and the perfect passive form σεσῳσμένοι without translating either by a single automatic formula.

sections.title: Ephesians 2:4–5 pieces
rows: made us alive together with Christ

items.grc: ὁ δὲ θεὸς πλούσιος ὢν ἐν ἐλέει διὰ τὴν πολλὴν ἀγάπην αὐτοῦ.
items.en: But God, being rich in mercy, because of his great love.

items.grc: καὶ ὄντας ἡμᾶς νεκροὺς τοῖς παραπτώμασιν συνεζωοποίησεν τῷ Χριστῷ.
items.en: Even while we were dead in transgressions, he made us alive together with Christ.
